Jordan —

Thanks for the heads up on the renewal window. Two quick items from my side before we get internal approvals across the finish line:

1) SOC 2 re-attestation: Our external auditors (Kitebridge) will need an evidence bundle covering the last 12 months plus a retention policy confirmation for logs/trace/audit exports. Specifically they asked for:
   - Access to immutable audit logs (read-only) covering API auth events, admin actions, and key rotation events
   - Exports of retention policy for object storage and retention windows for logs (we have a 13-month retention requirement)
   - A sample export we can forward to Kitebridge (they prefer newline-delimited JSON)

2) Capacity & term ask: Our platform usage has grown faster than expected. We want to add a dedicated pool equivalent to ~1200 TUs for the next term and are evaluating a 24-month commit. Please confirm if you can:
   - Provide a written amendment that adds the dedicated capacity line item and updates the MSA term to 24 months
   - Share an estimate of the cost delta (baseline + committed discount) and any migration credits for bringing the extra traffic over within the first 90 days

We'd like to run the attestation in late May so procurement can sign before the end of June. Can you confirm what you need from us and whether Redwood can host a read-only bucket for Kitebridge?

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Security Ops
